description: Compare two or more texts (or text files) for overlap. For every pair returns: Jaccard similarity of word shingles (k=3 words by default), a MinHash estimate of that Jaccard (128 hashes), and cosine similarity of word frequencies. Words are lower-cased, punctuation and Arabic diacritics ignored. Measures wording overlap, not meaning (no embeddings): paraphrases score low. Mode "pairs" (default) lists pairs sorted by the chosen metric; mode "dedupe" groups near-duplicates whose metric is at least "threshold" (default 0.8; groups are connected, so A~B and B~C put A, B, C together). Give "texts" (inline strings) and/or "paths" (file paths or base64). Up to 1000 texts.

labels.description: Optional names for the texts, in order (texts first, then paths). Default: "#1", "#2"… or the file name.

maxPairs.description: Most pairs to return (highest first). Default 200.

metric.description: Metric used to sort pairs and to group duplicates. Default jaccard.

mode.description: "pairs" (similarity of each pair) or "dedupe" (groups of near-duplicates).

paths.description: Or/also: UTF-8 text files (local paths or base64).

threshold.description: Dedupe: pairs at or above this are duplicates. Default 0.8.

name: ai_text_similarity
title: Text similarity and near-duplicates
